description: Oregon DEQ Clean Vehicle Rebate Program sample supporting documents, PDF page 3. Both faces carry SAMPLE. A 16-row optical recovery read the native back image using the PDF417 symbol alphabet and error correction. Payload values were never supplied to the optical reader.

provenance.verifiedBy: Native-image optical codeword classification and PDF417 error correction. 26 grid fits reproduced the same original bytes. Three decoders agreed on the classified symbol.
provenance.notes: No direct conventional scan of the compressed native JPEG succeeded. Decoder agreement uses shared optical preprocessing. The expected bytes are independently decoded.
